correctness.rationale: The equality fibre product W={u^a=v^b} is path connected: each finite solution follows (t^b u,t^a v) to (0,0) and infinity connects to (1,1) by reciprocal scaling, while both projections are onto. A strict planner near (0,0) would induce continuous functions h(x)^b=x^a and k(y)^a=y^b on small endpoint slices; winding around punctured disks forces b|a and a|b, hence a=b. Unequal exponents have no local planner even near one point, so TC=∞ despite synchronizability. Equal exponents duplicate any 3-set standard sphere path planner. Homotopy invariant lower bound follows because (a u-b v)^2=-2ab uv is nonzero in Q[u,v]/(u²,v²); upper bound pulls back a 3-set sphere ordinary planner to F,G. Independently checked exact fibre-product scaling identity for 128 exponent/time pairs; cohomology and winding arguments are exact universal proofs.
